bull.b: Proteus is showing meaningful performance advantages over the existing Platinum Pro system, including higher sequencing output and cleaner results. If these gains translate into a reliable commercial product, they could strengthen Quantum-Si’s competitive position, support customer adoption, and underpin a differentiated proteomics platform.

bull.t: Extended Cash Runway And Lower Operating Costs
bull.b: Lower expense and cash-use guidance improves financial flexibility during the Proteus commercialization period. The stated cash runway into the fourth quarter of 2028 gives management time to complete development, launch activities, and customer adoption efforts without an immediately pressing need for additional funding.

Coverage across detection technology, instruments, consumables, hardware, and amino acid recognizers can create barriers around multiple parts of the platform rather than a single product feature. Continued filings may help preserve differentiation as Quantum-Si expands its proteomics capabilities.

bear.b: The steep revenue decline shows that current commercial demand remains weak during the transition toward Proteus. Lower instrument and consumable activity reduces near-term scale, limits operating leverage, and increases dependence on successful future adoption of the new platform to rebuild the revenue base.

Sustained negative operating and free cash flow indicate that the existing business is not yet self-funding. Continued losses can consume capital needed for development and commercialization, while reliance on external funding may constrain strategic flexibility if Proteus adoption takes longer or costs more than expected.

bear.t: Proteus Commercialization And Supply-chain Execution Risk
bear.b: Longer component lead times and the need to purchase earlier and in larger quantities increase execution complexity ahead of launch. These actions may raise working-capital needs and create pressure on production readiness, even though management currently expects the Q2 2027 launch to remain on schedule.
